project.name: wedding-invitation
project.description: An enchanted cinematic digital wedding invitation web application for Inshu & Archit featuring a 3D animated opening envelope gate, video hero background, synchronized music playback, interactive scratch-to-reveal card with .ics export, photo gallery, real-time countdown, itinerary timeline, and venue maps.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Main home page orchestrating the interactive wedding invitation sequence: EnvelopeGate unlock, PetalField animation, background YouTube music toggle, hero video, personalized greeting, scratch-to-reveal section, photo carousel, countdown, itinerary timeline, venue details, and footer.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Root layout for Next.js App Router configuring HTML metadata (Cinematic Wedding Invitation), responsive viewport settings, typography classes, and global CSS inclusion.

nodes.name: not-found.tsx
nodes.summary: Custom 404 page styled with romantic wedding theme aesthetics directing lost visitors back to the main invitation.

nodes.name: EnvelopeGate.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-screen 3D interactive envelope gate that acts as a portal. Renders realistic gold-embossed wax seal, top flap 3D rotation, card slide-up animation, and triggers the experience unlock on user interaction.

nodes.name: HeroVideo.tsx
nodes.summary: Cinematic full-viewport hero section featuring background looping video, subtle scroll parallax animation, bride and groom names in gold serif typography, parental blessings, and scroll indicators.

nodes.name: MusicToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: Audio player controller embedding a hidden YouTube IFrame player. Manages audio playback lifecycle, volume normalization, precise start/end loop boundaries (0:17 - 1:20), autoplay on envelope unlock, and a floating toggle button.

nodes.name: ScratchReveal.tsx
nodes.summary: Heart-shaped interactive scratch canvas component utilizing HTML5 2D Canvas composite operations with touch/pointer tracking. Reveals the wedding date on scratch completion and generates downloadable .ics calendar files.

nodes.name: Gallery.tsx
nodes.summary: High-performance touch/pointer swipeable photo gallery featuring drag threshold detection, keyboard navigation, smooth spring-like transitions, counter badges, and thumbnail pagination dots.

nodes.name: Countdown.tsx
nodes.summary: Real-time wedding countdown timer displaying tabular animated days, hours, minutes, and seconds remaining until the ceremony date, with live expiration alerts.

nodes.name: Timeline.tsx
nodes.summary: Structured wedding event itinerary timeline rendering Haldi, Mehendi, Bhaat, Ring Ceremony & Sangeet, Phoolon ki Haldi, and Wedding Ceremony with scroll-reveal transitions and venue markers.

nodes.name: Venue.tsx
nodes.summary: Venue details card showing resort name, full address, custom architectural SVG illustration, and a direct Google Maps navigation button.

nodes.name: PetalField.tsx
nodes.summary: Lightweight falling rose petal ambient background particle effect with randomized CSS drift, duration, and stagger timings triggered once the envelope opens.

nodes.name: Reveal.tsx
nodes.summary: Scroll-triggered viewport entry animations wrapper (Reveal), decorative ornamental divider with gold heart (Divider), and typography section headers (SectionTitle).

nodes.name: invite.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth containing Sanskrit Ganesh Shloka, bride & groom biographies, parents lineage, ISO wedding date, multi-day itinerary milestones, venue address, RSVP contacts, and family slogans.

nodes.name: use-reveal.ts
nodes.summary: Custom React hook using IntersectionObserver to trigger performant one-shot CSS reveal transitions as elements scroll into the viewport.

nodes.name: use-mobile.tsx
nodes.summary: Responsive design hook evaluating matchMedia queries for mobile breakpoints (<768px).

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility helper combining clsx and tailwind-merge (cn function) for conflict-free Tailwind class resolution.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Master design system stylesheet defining OKLCH color palettes (rose, blush, gold, ivory), typography font families, 3D envelope keyframes, gate transitions, and custom utility classes.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Node project manifest declaring Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI primitives, Lucide icons, and build scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration enabling ESNext, strict type checks, JSX preservation, and path aliases (@/* -> src/*).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project documentation outlining the wedding invitation concept, Lovable deployment link, and local dev instructions.

layers.name: Interactive Experience Components
